description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) transmission entity in a 5G/4G mobile network stack. It includes state management, buffer handling, security, header compression, and transmission control for PDCP data units.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_state
classes.description: Represents the transmission state variables for a PDCP entity, including sequence numbers for transmission, reordering, and acknowledgment.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_buffer_info
classes.description: Helper structure for passing buffer information to security functions, including re-transmission status, count, buffer, and crypto token.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_pdu_info
classes.description: Helper structure for passing PDUs and metadata to lower layers, including PDU buffer, count, and time of arrival.

classes.name: pdcp_entity_tx
classes.description: Final class implementing the PDCP transmission entity, managing SDU handling, security, header compression, retransmissions, and state management.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops handling SDUs and timers for the PDCP entity.

methods.name: crypto_awaitable
methods.description: Returns an awaitable event flag to wait for completion of crypto tasks.

methods.name: notify_pdu_processing_stopped
methods.description: Notifies that PDU processing has stopped.

methods.name: restart_pdu_processing
methods.description: Restarts PDU processing after a stop.

methods.name: reestablish
methods.description: Triggers re-establishment of the PDCP entity as per 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: begin_buffering
methods.description: Starts buffering SDUs.

methods.name: end_buffering
methods.description: Ends buffering and flushes current SDUs.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends the PDCP TX entity, pausing transmission.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the PDCP TX entity from suspension.

methods.name: get_count
methods.description: Retrieves current transmission count info for status transfer.

methods.name: set_count
methods.description: Sets the transmission count info for status transfer.

methods.name: set_status_provider
methods.description: Sets the status provider for inter-layer communication.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs for transmission.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Handles transmit notifications for PDUs.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Handles delivery notifications for PDUs.

methods.name: handle_retransmit_notification
methods.description: Handles retransmit notifications for PDUs.

methods.name: handle_delivery_retransmitted_notification
methods.description: Handles delivery retransmission notifications.

methods.name: handle_desired_buffer_size_notification
methods.description: Handles notifications for desired buffer size.

methods.name: handle_status_report
methods.description: Evaluates a PDCP status report.

methods.name: consume_rohc_feedback
methods.description: Processes ROHC feedback received from peer.

methods.name: forward_rohc_feedback
methods.description: Forwards ROHC feedback to peer.

methods.name: prepend_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Prepends header to a data PDU.

methods.name: prepend_control_pdu_header
methods.description: Prepends header to a control PDU.

methods.name: configure_security
methods.description: Configures security parameters for the PDCP entity.

methods.name: send_status_report
methods.description: Sends a PDCP status report.

methods.name: data_recovery
methods.description: Performs data recovery as per 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the PDCP entity state and timers.

methods.name: retransmit_all_pdus
methods.description: Retransmits all PDUs with security re-applied.

methods.name: get_metrics_and_reset
methods.description: Retrieves and resets transmission metrics.

methods.name: check_early_drop
methods.description: Checks if early dropping of SDUs is needed based on buffer conditions.

methods.name: apply_reordering
methods.description: Applies ciphering and integrity protection for reordering.

methods.name: write_data_pdu_to_lower_layers
methods.description: Sends data PDU to lower layers.

methods.name: write_control_pdu_to_lower_layers
methods.description: Sends control PDU to lower layers.

methods.name: apply_security
methods.description: Applies security (ciphering and integrity) to SDUs.

methods.name: apply_ciphering_and_integrity_protection
methods.description: Performs ciphering and integrity protection on payload.

methods.name: init_header_compression
methods.description: Initializes header compression (ROHC).

methods.name: apply_header_compression
methods.description: Compresses SDU headers if applicable.

methods.name: notification_count_estimation
methods.description: Estimates notification count for retransmission.

methods.name: stop_discard_timer
methods.description: Stops discard timers up to a specified PDCP PDU count.

methods.name: discard_pdu
methods.description: Discards a specific PDU.

methods.name: get_pdu_size
methods.description: Estimates size of a PDU from an SDU.

methods.name: discard_callback
methods.description: Callback for discard timer expiration.

methods.name: crypto_reordering_timeout
methods.description: Callback for crypto reordering timer expiration.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification_impl
methods.description: Implementation for handling transmit/retransmit notifications.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification_impl
methods.description: Implementation for handling delivery/retransmission notifications.

methods.name: handle_reordering_timeout
methods.description: Handles reordering timeout events.
